checks.message: RC16-022 must run after RC16-021 completed, either while current_task is RC16-022 or while rerunning after pointer advancement.
RC16-022 must consume the RC16 rollback/support package contract.
RC16-022 must consume completed RC16-021 install/update PlanSpec and SecurityExecution envelope evidence without effects.
Rollback baseline, support index, and package/media identity must be hash-bound for distributable install/update.
RC16-022 must bind RC15 controlled rollback/support evidence while not executing rollback in RC16.
Support bundle manifest and recovery references must be redacted, local-only, and non-executing.
Package must list post-install/update observation needs before any future effect authority can be prepared.
Release artifact documentation and agentd support bundle code must encode recovery source of truth and redaction expectations.
Missing rollback/support refs, unredacted bundles, support upload, recovery execution, remote dispatch, mutation, private material, and display-surface authority cases must fail closed.

RC16-022 must not install, update, rollback, upload support, execute recovery, dispatch remotely, mutate slots/boot metadata/artifact sets, handle private signing material, or mutate production rings.
RC16-022 package output must not contain key blocks, private key paths, auth tokens, or public identity markers.
